description:
List New Zealand public holidays for a year, count them, and find the next one.

    Use for: 'public holidays nz 2027', 'when is the next public holiday nz',
    'how many public holidays in nz', 'is waitangi day mondayised', 'when is
    matariki 2028', 'auckland anniversary day', 'nz stat holidays'.

    THE COUNT IS NOT ALWAYS ELEVEN. Ten before Matariki began in 2022, twelve
    in 2022 with the one-off Queen Elizabeth II Memorial Day, eleven since, plus
    one for a region's anniversary day.

    MONDAYISATION MOVES THE DAY OFF, NOT THE HOLIDAY. For someone who does not
    work that weekend day, Christmas, Boxing Day, 1 and 2 January move from a
    Saturday to the Monday and from a Sunday to the TUESDAY (so a Sunday
    Christmas is Tuesday 27 and Boxing Day Monday 26). Waitangi Day and Anzac
    Day move to the Monday, and only from 2014. Each holiday carries both actual_date and date (the
    day off), with mondayised set when they differ.

    TWO HOLIDAYS CAN SHARE A DAY. Anzac Day fell on Easter Monday in 2011 and is
    Mondayised onto it in 2038. distinct_days_off counts the day once.

    MATARIKI is gazetted, not calculated, and is listed only from 2022. The
    gazetted dates run to 2052, which is the last year this covers.

    REGIONAL ANNIVERSARY DAYS are given on the day OBSERVED, which is rarely
    the anniversary: usually the Monday nearest it (Auckland 29 January was
    observed Monday 26 January 2026), but Taranaki is the second Monday in
    March, Southland Easter Tuesday, Canterbury Show Day Friday in November,
    South Canterbury the fourth Monday in September, Hawke's Bay the Friday
    before Labour Day and Marlborough the Monday after (Employment New
    Zealand). Each regional entry carries actual_date (the anniversary) and
    date (the day off). Available from 2010.

    Args:
        year: Calendar year, 2000 to 2052. Defaults to the year of after, or
            the current year.
        region: Optional anniversary region key, for example auckland,
            wellington, canterbury, otago. Omit for national holidays only.
        after: Optional ISO date. Returns the next holiday strictly after it.

    Returns:
        Every holiday with its actual and observed date, the national,
        regional and distinct day counts, and the next holiday when asked.
name: nz_public_holidays_calculator
